subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should progress mode always use a fresh model preamble as its status headline, or should this PR be narrowed to the time-gate and deferred-narration fixes?
rationale: Using preambles as an always-on headline changes default user-visible channel behavior, while the linked issue remains marked for a product decision and the repository has a high bar for adding a configuration escape hatch.

options.title: Approve Always-On Headlines
options.body: Keep the typed-preamble headline as the default after fixing retraction identity and proving the refreshed merged head across visible channel flows.

options.title: Narrow To Gate Fix
options.body: Ship only the time-based gate and narration deferral, leaving existing labels and commentary presentation unchanged.

options.title: Add An Opt-In Setting
options.body: Make preamble headlines configurable, accepting another persistent config surface and its documentation and compatibility burden.

recommendation.title: Approve Always-On Headlines
recommendation.body: Keep the typed-preamble headline as the default after fixing retraction identity and proving the refreshed merged head across visible channel flows.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the linked product proposal and implementation and is the strongest available owner for the intended default behavior.
